questions.stem: If the mass of an object doubles but the same force is applied, what happens to the acceleration?
questions.explanation: From F = ma, acceleration = F/m. If mass doubles and force stays the same, acceleration is halved. Acceleration is inversely proportional to mass.

questions.stem: What resultant force is needed to accelerate a 1500 kg car at 2 m/s²?
questions.explanation: F = ma = 1500 kg x 2 m/s² = 3000 N.
